g.text: Milliseconds / operation; observed median and min/max
fstat + version formatting: ~0.43-0.46us. Lock + unlock: ~0.46-0.49us. Source and result scans are retained.
E59:363 block records (2 warmup +9 evaluation blocks). E61:153 diagnostics (1 warmup +9 evaluation blocks).
Block means cover8 or64 handler operations. Independent probe medians cannot be added to reconstruct task time.
Large whole-file writes are C-handler controls; CLI args stay1KiB. Cloud model/network time is excluded.
All negative pairs retained. No general speedup, p95/p99, RSS or physical-KV claim.
